<gp_project_root ver="1"> <gallery> <tool name="SummarizeNearby" type="script" toolboxalias="analysis" gallery_group="Summarize Data"> <displayname>Summarize Nearby</displayname> <description>Finds features that are within a specified distance of features in the input layer and calculates statistics for the nearby features. Distance can be measured as a straight-line distance, a drive-time distance (for example, within 10 minutes), or a drive distance (within 5 kilometers). Drive-time and drive distance measurements require that you are logged in to an ArcGIS Online organizational account with Network Analysis privileges, and they consume credits.</description> </tool> <tool name="SummarizeWithin" type="script" toolboxalias="analysis" gallery_group="Summarize Data"> <displayname>Summarize Within</displayname> <description>Overlays a polygon layer with another layer to summarize the number of points, length of the lines, or area of the polygons within each polygon, and calculate attribute field statistics about those features within the polygons.</description> </tool> <tool name="Statistics" type="function" toolboxalias="analysis" gallery_group="Summarize Data"> <displayname>Summary Statistics</displayname> <description>Calculates summary statistics for field(s) in a table.</description> </tool> <tool name="Enrich" type="function" toolboxalias="analysis" gallery_group="Enrich Data"> <displayname>Enrich</displayname> <description>Enriches data by adding demographic and landscape facts about the people and places that surround or are inside data locations. The output is a duplicate of your input with additional attribute fields. This tool requires an ArcGIS Online organizational account or a locally installed Business Analyst dataset.</description> </tool> <tool name="Clip" type="function" toolboxalias="analysis" gallery_group="Overlay Data"> <displayname>Clip</displayname> <description>Extracts input features that overlay the clip features.</description> </tool> <tool name="Intersect" type="function" toolboxalias="analysis" gallery_group="Overlay Data"> <displayname>Intersect</displayname> <description>Computes a geometric intersection of the input features. Features or portions of features which overlap in all layers and/or feature classes will be written to the output feature class.</description> </tool> <tool name="Union" type="function" toolboxalias="analysis" gallery_group="Overlay Data"> <displayname>Union</displayname> <description>Computes a geometric union of the input features. All features and their attributes will be written to the output feature class.</description> </tool> <tool name="SpatialJoin" type="function" toolboxalias="analysis" gallery_group="Overlay Data"> <displayname>Spatial Join</displayname> <description>Joins attributes from one feature to another based on the spatial relationship. The target features and the joined attributes from the join features are written to the output feature class.</description> </tool> <tool name="KernelDensity" type="function" toolboxalias="sa" gallery_group="Analyze Patterns"> <displayname>Kernel Density</displayname> <description>Calculates a magnitude-per-unit area from point or polyline features using a kernel function to fit a smoothly tapered surface to each point or polyline.</description> </tool> <tool name="OptimizedHotSpotAnalysis" type="pythonscript" toolboxalias="stats" gallery_group="Analyze Patterns"> <displayname>Optimized Hot Spot Analysis</displayname> <description>Given incident points or weighted features (points or polygons), creates a map of statistically significant hot and cold spots using the Getis-Ord Gi* statistic. It evaluates the characteristics of the input feature class to produce optimal results.</description> </tool> <tool name="OptimizedOutlierAnalysis" type="pythonscript" toolboxalias="stats" gallery_group="Analyze Patterns"> <displayname>Optimized Outlier Analysis</displayname> <description>Given incident points or weighted features (points or polygons), creates a map of statistically significant hot spots, cold spots, and spatial outliers using the Anselin Local Moran's I statistic. It evaluates the characteristics of the input feature class to produce optimal results.</description> </tool> <tool name="SpatiallyConstrainedMultivariateClustering" type="pythonscript" toolboxalias="stats" gallery_group="Analyze Patterns"> <displayname>Spatially Constrained Multivariate Clustering</displayname> <description>Finds spatially contiguous clusters of features based on a set of feature attribute values and optional cluster size limits.</description> </tool> <tool name="EmpiricalBayesianKriging" type="function" toolboxalias="ga" gallery_group="Analyze Patterns"> <displayname>Empirical Bayesian Kriging</displayname> <description>Empirical Bayesian kriging is an interpolation method that accounts for the error in estimating the underlying semivariogram through repeated simulations.</description> </tool> <tool name="Buffer" type="function" toolboxalias="analysis" gallery_group="Determine Proximity"> <displayname>Buffer</displayname> <description>Creates buffer polygons around input features to a specified distance.</description> </tool> <tool name="Near" type="function" toolboxalias="analysis" gallery_group="Determine Proximity"> <displayname>Near</displayname> <description>Calculates distance and additional proximity information between the input features and the closest feature in another layer or feature class.</description> </tool> <tool name="GenerateNearTable" type="function" toolboxalias="analysis" gallery_group="Determine Proximity"> <displayname>Generate Near Table</displayname> <description>Calculates distances and other proximity information between features in one or more feature class or layer. Unlike the Near tool, which modifies the input, Generate Near Table writes results to a new stand-alone table and supports finding more than one near feature.</description> </tool> <tool name="AddField" type="function" toolboxalias="management" gallery_group="Manage Data"> <displayname>Add Field</displayname> <description>Adds a new field to a table or the table of a feature class, feature layer, and/or rasters with attribute tables.</description> </tool> <tool name="CalculateField" type="function" toolboxalias="management" gallery_group="Manage Data"> <displayname>Calculate Field</displayname> <description>Calculates the values of a field for a feature class, feature layer, or raster.</description> </tool> <tool name="Dissolve" type="function" toolboxalias="management" gallery_group="Manage Data"> <displayname>Dissolve</displayname> <description>Aggregates features based on specified attributes.</description> </tool> <tool name="Append" type="function" toolboxalias="management" gallery_group="Manage Data"> <displayname>Append</displayname> <description>Appends multiple input datasets into an existing target dataset. Input datasets can be feature classes, tables, shapefiles, rasters, annotation or dimensions feature classes.</description> </tool> <tool name="Merge" type="function" toolboxalias="management" gallery_group="Manage Data"> <displayname>Merge</displayname> <description>Combines multiple input datasets into a single, new output dataset.
